## Validation and limitations

The search retrieved **4/4 (100.0%)** records in the development set discovered during the build. That is relative recall against a small, non-independent set—not an estimate of absolute sensitivity. There was no held-out validation set or prior-review benchmark.

The strategy is deliberately broad; expect substantial screening. PubMed’s coverage of social and behavioural science methods is limited, and this search does not cover records indexed only in other databases. Human PRESS peer review by an information specialist is still needed before use.
